race.title: wetherbyracing.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and I HEARD A RUMOUR gets a confident vote to make light of a 10 lb rise in the weights for her comfortable Chepstow victory, with this longer trip also rating a plus for Dan Skelton's upwardly-mobile mare. Southwell runner-up Moveonbuy appeals as the one to chase her home ahead of Mr Ramoon and Masterminding . I HEARD A RUMOUR (IRE) MOVEONBUY MR RAMOON (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: I Heard A Rumour (13/8), Glory Hights (13/2), Mr Ramoon (7/1), Moveonbuy (7/1), Masterminding (15/2), Smart Bucks (10/1), Matoury (14/1), Getaway Master (14/1), Jacenry (20/1), It's Party Time (20/1), Final Straw (33/1), Rock Armour (50/1)
